gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-sharada: Noto Sans Sharada carries bulky lowercase proportions and c forms that never read as closed rings. Noto Sans Sharada handles the steady text while Tilt Neon spends its flat, unmodulated strokes on being loud.
